taskId.description: The swarm task id this run implemented (given in the prompt).

status.description: done = acceptance + gates + /double-check complete; blocked = could not finish.

summary.description: 2-4 sentence summary of what was built/changed and why.

filesChanged.description: Repo-relative paths of every file created, edited, or deleted.

verification.description: Exact commands run to self-verify (lint/typecheck/tests) and their outcomes.

doubleCheck.description: Result of the mandatory /double-check skill pass. status=done MUST be complete; incomplete/partial → use status=blocked.

blockedReason.description: Required when status=blocked: what is blocking and what the coordinator should do.

outOfScopeNotes.description: Anything noticed outside the owned file set that the coordinator should know (do NOT fix it yourself).
